## Wave 1 Summary

This wave resolves the L_max-envelope axis with TWO coordinated computes (JOINT-CONSIDERATION per dedup-ledger (c)) so the branch-(iv) `w_0` truncation envelope (item 1, `S105-BRANCH-IV-DIRECT-L1314`) and the loop-counting Friedrich-Bär binding determination (item 2, `S105-LOOP-COUNTING-BINDING`) are never double-scheduled and share no machinery pins. Both descend from S104 PRE-REG-INC / INFO carry-forwards that were machinery-blocked, not physics-blocked.

**Item 1** lifts the S104 irrep-construction wall (`S104-BRANCH-IV-DIRECT-L1314: PRE-REG-INC -- value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_irrep_construction_wall_Sym13_Sym14'`, audit `b48b609f8392be5a4d54e4c3a5e14a5f02c0c95ec919860e951918b848adb8ff`): the dense `3^p` intermediate-construction path is impossible (Sym^13 ≈ 40.7 TB, Sym^14 ≈ 366 TB), but the (p,0) irreps are finite-dimensional (dim_sym = (p+1)(p+2)/2 = 105 at p=13, 120 at p=14) and exist. A Gelfand-Tsetlin / monomial-basis builder constructs the rep DIRECTLY in the dim_sym space, never forming `3^p`. With (0,13)/(13,0)/(0,14)/(14,0) built, the 13 missing level-14 mixed sectors become buildable via the existing Casimir-projection path, and the DIRECT `spread_CAC` gate over L ∈ {12,13,14} re-runs against the UNCHANGED W5-2 band.

**Item 2** performs the numerical Case-A/B binding reduction the S104 spec deferred (`S104-LOOP-COUNTING-ENVELOPE-SPEC: INFO -- ...registry=INCOMPLETE-PENDING_S105prereq=numerical_reduction_f=w.g_vs_alpha_loop`, audit `a6a0a753d0a7fb95a2011412d7a0750b401ace3ed086f0b239d908d0465e7e4c`): does a NORMALIZED Hermitian-D_K moment carry a convergence whose `L^{−α}` rate is the §VII.AF.1 HKR image (Case A → Level-2-BINDING, licenses a future registry-landing compute) or the W16 bare Mellin-truncation rate (Case B → confirm-internal note, the envelope question stays internal)? The (A)/(B) discriminator is UNCHANGED from the S104 §W5-4 pre-registration (Case-B reduction to a cancellation identity was already FALSIFIED at spec time; Case-A shape was satisfied with `c_continuum = w_m` DEFINED; the two obstructions named were hermiticity of Tr|D_K|^m and the absence of an HKR/Connes-Karoubi map of w_m to a substrate Level-1 class).

## Wave 1 Decision Point Prerequisites

**Upstream verdicts gating this wave** (all S104 or earlier — verdict file `computations/session-104/s104_gate_verdicts.txt`):

- Item 1 consumes `s104_sym_p_chain_cache_L1314.npz` (the 12 GPU-verified mixed level-13 sectors, `iD_herm_err ≤ 1.0e-15`, produced by `S104-BRANCH-IV-DIRECT-L1314` Phase-1) + `s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz` (the L≤12 master cache). Both exist on disk; neither is an in-session prerequisite. The S103 Friedrich-Bär envelope INFO (`S103-BRANCH-IV-DEEP-TRUNCATION`, audit `508c7cf3...`) stands as the best-bound prior; item 1 supersedes it on PASS/INFO/FAIL by direct evaluation.
- Item 2 consumes `s104_loop_counting_envelope_spec.npz` (the named `c_continuum = w_m`, discriminator record, emitted by `S104-LOOP-COUNTING-ENVELOPE-SPEC`) + `s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz`. Both exist; neither is an in-session prerequisite.

**JOINT-CONSIDERATION constraint (BINDING at plan-freeze)** — per `session-104-housekeeping.md` §"Consumption pointers" + the S104 w5 WP §W5-4 ADJACENCY note (mirrored into the S104 LOOP-COUNTING-ENVELOPE-SPEC verdict-line value: `JOINT-CONSIDERATION_with_S104-VIIAM-L11-ANCHOR_S104-BRANCH-IV-DIRECT-L1314_no_double-schedule`):

> `CF-S105-LOOP-COUNTING-BINDING-REDUCTION` (item 2) ↔ `CF-S105-BRANCH-IV-GT-BUILDER` (item 1) ↔ any §VII.AM L-scan follow-on SHARE the L_max axis. They are ONE coordinated wave (Wave 1) so the loop-counting α_loop convergence rate and the branch-(iv) Friedrich-Bär envelope are NOT double-scheduled at S105 plan-freeze. Both items scan along L_max but on STRUCTURALLY DISJOINT observables: item 1 evaluates `ρ_B(L)` (branch-(iv) late-time `w_0` spectral moment, the Mellin-zeta `w_0` channel); item 2 evaluates `r(m,L)` (the relative finite-to-continuum difference of a normalized Hermitian-D_K moment). **No shared machinery pins** — the two `machinery_pin_map` blocks below have no overlapping keyed value (different observable, different cache-projection, different convention; only the L_max axis and the shared read-only `s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz` input are common, and a read-only cache input is not a machinery pin). The §VII.AF.1 `L^{−3}` envelope shape is the BINDING EXEMPLAR consumed by item 2 ONLY; item 1's Friedrich-Bär envelope is the branch-(iv) saturation argument consumed by item 1 ONLY. Neither item's verdict feeds the other's input (no intra-wave sequencing).

If `s104_sym_p_chain_cache_L1314.npz` or `s104_loop_counting_envelope_spec.npz` is absent or SHA-mismatched at dispatch time, the affected gate honestly closes per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` (PRE-REG-INC, `value='upstream_<cache>_absent'`), NOT a FAIL.

```yaml
    irrep constructor that builds the representation DIRECTLY in the dim_sym = (p+1)(p+2)/2 highest-weight

    GATING): for every already-cached (p,0) sector with p ≤ 12 in s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz,
    the new GT (p,0) D_K eigenvalue spectrum MUST reproduce the cache eigenvalues bit-exact
    (max|λ_GT − λ_cache| = 0.0, the rho_recompute_sentinel; the S104 predecessor already certified

    level-13 mixed sectors at iD_herm_err ≤ 1.0e-15). Union: {s84 L≤12 cache} ∪ {12 cached mixed

  regulator_pin: "a_2^{Mellin} — the branch-(iv) w_0 channel is the substrate-distance Mellin-zeta moment (zeta scheme); any Seeley-DeWitt a_n citation in the producing script carries the Mellin regulator tag per regulator-pin-discipline.md; pole convention poleconv-A-double (zeta_{D_K}(s)=Sum m_k lambda_k^{-2s}, s=3 substrate-distance-1)"
  publication_precision: "6 sig figs — spread_CAC and rho_B(L) reported to 6 sig figs (matching the FB-prior rho_B(13)=-0.646653 / rho_B(14)=-0.657020 published precision); full float64 to .npz, rounded to WP"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical_constants", "s104_sym_p_chain_cache_L1314.npz", "s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — offset-cancellation (the S104-verified chain, carried forward); spread_CAC is offset-FREE
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "spread_CAC is offset-FREE — the additive CAC translation offset_B cancels exactly in the
    span over L in {12,13,14}, so the PASS<=0.025 band test is identical whether applied to w_0_FW(L)
    or to the raw moment rho_B(L)."

    Definition 1: w_0_FW(L) := rho_B(L) + offset_B
                  [CAC, regulator-convention-lockdown.md; rho_B(L) = branch-(iv) late-time w_0
                   Mellin-zeta spectral moment at truncation L; offset_X is the additive constant]
    Definition 2: offset_B := w_0_FW - rho_B(L=10)
                  [offset anchored at L_anchor=10; w_0_FW = -0.918 canonical, get_constant(w0_FW);
                   offset_B is a SINGLE constant DERIVED at runtime from the L=10 residual — it has
                   NO dependence on the scan index L]
    Definition 3: spread_CAC := max_{L in {12,13,14}} w_0_FW(L) - min_{L in {12,13,14}} w_0_FW(L)
                  [the 3-point span; the band observable]

    Substitute (Def 1 into Def 3, no simplification):
        spread_CAC = max_{L in {12,13,14}} [ rho_B(L) + offset_B ]
                   - min_{L in {12,13,14}} [ rho_B(L) + offset_B ]

    Simplify (offset_B is an L-INDEPENDENT additive constant, so it factors out of BOTH the max and
    the min identically — adding the same constant to every element of a finite set shifts both the
    max and the min by that constant):
        = ( max_{L in {12,13,14}} rho_B(L) + offset_B ) - ( min_{L in {12,13,14}} rho_B(L) + offset_B )
        = max_{L in {12,13,14}} rho_B(L) + offset_B - min_{L in {12,13,14}} rho_B(L) - offset_B
        = max_{L in {12,13,14}} rho_B(L) - min_{L in {12,13,14}} rho_B(L)

    Canonical form:
        spread_CAC = max_{L in {12,13,14}} rho_B(L) - min_{L in {12,13,14}} rho_B(L)

    Direction: spread_CAC depends ONLY on the raw moment span; offset_B has cancelled EXACTLY (residual
    = 0 by algebra, no float cancellation issue since the same offset_B object subtracts from itself).
    The band test PASS iff spread_CAC <= 0.025 reads directly off the rho_B span.

    Conclusion: the CAC additive translation cancels exactly in the span; CAC vs RDC differ ONLY by the
    additive offset, so the SPREAD is identical under either — but CAC is MANDATORY per
    regulator-convention-lockdown.md because (a) the offset anchors w_0_FW(L=10) = w_0_FW EXACTLY
    (effacement-preservation / demarcation theorem) which RDC violates, and (b) the verdict-line value=
    field reports w_0_FW(L) absolute values (not just the span), where the offset is load-bearing.
    Therefore: evaluate w_0_FW(L) under CAC for the reported absolute moments; the spread_CAC band test
    is offset-invariant and equals the rho_B-span test.
```

## §W1-2. S105-LOOP-COUNTING-BINDING

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S105-LOOP-COUNTING-BINDING"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"                          # two-branch binding determination (Case A vs Case B); the (A)/(B) discriminator is the pre-registered set-membership decision
classification: "GEOMETRIC"                  # convergence rate of a normalized Hermitian-D_K spectral moment vs the VII.AF.1 HKR image; spectral-triple structure, the fabric itself
agent_type: "lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist"  # the lizzi-axis sharp question (named verbatim in the context): does a NORMALIZED Hermitian-D_K moment carry the VII.AF.1 HKR-image rate or the W16 bare rate; owns the spectral-functional + HKR/Connes-Karoubi binding analysis
hypothesis: "A NORMALIZED Hermitian-D_K spectral moment M_m^{D_K} = Tr|D_K|^m / Tr|D_K|^0 admits a finite-to-continuum relative difference r(m,L) = ||M_m^{(L)} - w_m|| / w_m whose L^{-alpha} convergence is EITHER (Case A) a nameable HKR-image bounding ||HKR(c_L) - w_m|| -> Level-2-BINDING, OR (Case B) the W16 bare Mellin-truncation rate with no HKR image -> Level-2-non-binding (confirm-internal)."

method:
  description: >
    Numerical Case-A/B binding reduction on a NORMALIZED Hermitian-D_K moment. Construct
    M_m^{(L)} = Tr|D_K^{(L)}|^m / Tr|D_K^{(L)}|^0 from the s84 L=12 fold spectrum, truncated at p+q<=L
    over the scan set L in [10, Friedrich-Bar cutoff] (operationally L in {10,11,12}; the FB cutoff is
    L=12 for the s84 master cache without new irrep construction — this gate does NOT build new sectors,
    keeping it disjoint from item 1's GT path). Load the named c_continuum = w_m from
    s104_loop_counting_envelope_spec.npz. Compute r(m,L) = |M_m^{(L)} - w_m| / w_m and fit the
    L-convergence exponent alpha via log-log regression over the scan set.
    DISCRIMINATOR (UNCHANGED from the S104 S104-LOOP-COUNTING-ENVELOPE-SPEC pre-registration; the
    binding_class token there was 'candidate-A-on-structure_HKR-image-UNDECIDED-at-spec-time_pending-numerical-reduction',
    Case-B reduction to a cancellation identity ALREADY FALSIFIED, Case-A shape satisfied with
    c_continuum=w_m DEFINED):
      Case A (Level-2-BINDING): r(m,L) -> 0 as L grows AT the VII.AF.1 L^{-3} (d=4, substrate-distance-1
        pole s=3) rate (|alpha_fit - 3| within the pre-registered tolerance) AND a nameable HKR /
        Connes-Karoubi / K-theory-boundary image phi exists mapping M_m^{D_K} to a substrate Level-1
        cohomology class such that r(m,L) operationally bounds ||HKR(c_L) - w_m||. -> licenses a future
        registry-landing compute (NOT landed this wave).
      Case B (Level-2-non-binding / confirm-internal): r(m,L) reduces to the bare Mellin-truncation rate
        (the constraint-mega-matrix W16 wall: 'Substrate-internal Mellin-truncation rate cannot pose as
        cross-pillar bridge evidence; HKR map citation MANDATORY for registry-PASS') with NO nameable

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: "binding_class in {Case-A-Level-2-BINDING, Case-B-Level-2-non-binding}; Case A iff (|alpha_fit - 3| <= tol_alpha) AND (HKR image nameable, boolean); else Case B"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — non-numerical two-branch gate; PASS criterion is the (A)/(B) decision
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "N/A — two-branch binding determination (set-membership). The decision content is the conjunction (|alpha_fit - 3| <= tol_alpha) AND (HKR-image-nameable == True) for Case A; the alpha sub-test threshold tol_alpha is pinned in machinery_pin_map.tolerance"
  direction: "N/A — set-membership, not a scalar inequality"

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "the VII.AF.1 L^{-3} envelope is analytically derived (permanent-results-registry.md §VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ: L^{-3} at d=4 substrate-distance-1 pole s=3, Sage-verified rate(10)=10^{-3}=0.10%); the Case-A alpha target alpha=3 is the analytic HKR-image rate; Case-B is the complement"

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "the alpha-target is the integer 3 (the VII.AF.1 L^{-3} exponent); the binding decision is a two-element set {A, B}; the L scan {10,11,12} is a 3-point integer mesh"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "all-eigenvalues — full |D_K| spectrum from s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz truncated at p+q<=L for each L in {10,11,12}; M_m = Tr|D_K|^m / Tr|D_K|^0 is a full-spectrum moment ratio"
  L_max: "12 (FB cutoff for the s84 master cache; scan set {10,11,12}; NO new irrep construction — disjoint from item 1's GT path)"

  step_size: "N/A — discrete 3-point L set"
  tolerance: "tol_alpha = 0.30 (|alpha_fit - 3| <= 0.30 for the Case-A rate match; matches the cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §9 empirical-beta 10%-of-target band loosened to a 3-point in-cache fit where the asymptotic regression is cache-ceiling-limited; the in-cache log-log fit is DIAGNOSTIC, the binding decision additionally requires HKR-image nameability); moment order m pinned below"
  scheme: "Mellin"
  convention: "SUBSTRATE-IS-TRUNCATION-ENVELOPE-NAMING — VERBATIM from the S104 predecessor verdict-line convention; the normalized Hermitian-D_K moment is a substrate-IS truncation observable; Level-2 sub-class declared per cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §'Level-2 sub-class' (binding iff HKR image nameable; non-binding = bare-decomposition rate)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (moment ratios + log-log fit are deterministic)"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg for the per-block |D_K| construction (the s84 cache blocks are pre-diagonalized; |lambda| moments are elementwise on the cached eigenvalues — CPU-cheap; cap OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 if numpy path used per math-scripts.md)"
  # CONDITIONAL machinery pins:
  regulator_pin: "a_n^{Mellin} — any Seeley-DeWitt a_n citation in the producing script (the VII.AF.1 envelope is a Mellin-cone residue at s=3) carries the Mellin regulator tag per regulator-pin-discipline.md; pole convention poleconv-A-double, (pole_in_s=3, curvature_grade_n=2); the W16-bare alternative (Case B) is the a_n^{Mellin} bare-decomposition rate with no HKR image"
  moment_order_m: "m = 2 (the normalized second moment Tr|D_K|^2 / Tr|D_K|^0 — the Seeley-DeWitt a_2-weighted spectral moment, the load-bearing curvature-degree-2 grading matching the VII.AF.1 substrate-distance-1 pole; pinned at plan-freeze, NOT scanned, to avoid m-shopping)"
  publication_precision: "4 sig figs — alpha_fit and r(m,L) reported to 4 sig figs (the binding decision is categorical {A,B}; the alpha fit is diagnostic-precision)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical_constants", "s104_loop_counting_envelope_spec.npz", "s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — the binding-determination direction (Case A vs Case B)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The binding class is Case A (Level-2-BINDING) iff r(m,L) converges to 0 at the VII.AF.1
    L^{-3} rate AND a nameable HKR image exists; otherwise Case B (Level-2-non-binding, the W16 wall).
    The decision is offset-free and does not pre-judge the outcome."

    Definition 1: M_m^{D_K} := Tr|D_K|^m / Tr|D_K|^0
                  [normalized Hermitian-D_K spectral moment, m=2 PINNED; |D_K| is the positive
                   self-adjoint modulus, so the moment is real and the hermiticity obstruction
                   (S104 obstruction-1) is removed by construction]
    Definition 2: w_m := the named c_continuum from s104_loop_counting_envelope_spec.npz
                  [the S104 spec emitted c_continuum=w_m DEFINED; this is the reference continuum value
                   the finite-L moment converges toward]
    Definition 3: r(m,L) := |M_m^{(L)} - w_m| / w_m
                  [the finite-to-continuum RELATIVE difference at truncation L; the convergence-rate
                   observable]
    Definition 4: alpha_fit := -d(log r)/d(log L) fitted by log-log regression over L in {10,11,12}
                  [the empirical convergence exponent; VII.AF.1 predicts alpha=3 at d=4 pole s=3]

    Substitute (the two-branch decision, no simplification — this is a set-membership test, not an
    algebraic reduction):
        binding_class = Case-A  iff  ( |alpha_fit - 3| <= tol_alpha )  AND  ( exists nameable HKR /
                                       Connes-Karoubi / K-theory-boundary image phi : M_m^{D_K} ->
                                       Level-1 substrate cohomology class, s.t. r(m,L) bounds
                                       ||HKR(c_L) - w_m|| )
        binding_class = Case-B  otherwise  ( r(m,L) is the bare a_n^{Mellin} truncation-decomposition
                                             rate with NO HKR image — the constraint-mega-matrix W16
                                             wall: substrate-internal Mellin-truncation rate cannot
                                             pose as cross-pillar bridge evidence )

    Simplify (the two obstructions the S104 spec named, resolved as explicit sub-tests, NOT asserted):
        obstruction-1 (hermiticity): RESOLVED by Def 1 — |D_K| is Hermitian-positive, so Tr|D_K|^m is
            real and the 'no Hermitian-D_K directed-loop analog' obstruction does not apply to the
            NORMALIZED modulus moment.
        obstruction-2 (HKR map): TESTED, not assumed — the Case-A conjunct's second clause is exactly
            'exists nameable HKR image'; if NO image is nameable, the gate lands Case B regardless of
            the alpha fit (a bare rate at the L^{-3} value is STILL non-binding per the Level-2 sub-class
            rule — binding requires the HKR image, not merely the matching exponent).

    Canonical form:
        binding_class = Case-A  <=>  (rate-match alpha_fit ~ 3)  AND  (HKR-image nameable)
        binding_class = Case-B  <=>  NOT[ (rate-match) AND (HKR-image nameable) ]

    Direction: the decision is a CONJUNCTION (both the rate AND the named image), not a disjunction —
    a matching exponent alone is INSUFFICIENT for binding (per cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md
    §'Level-2 sub-class': Level-2-binding requires an HKR image that BINDS Level-1; Level-2-non-binding
    is a bare-decomposition rate even when the exponent matches). This preserves the open-verdict framing
    (epistemic-discipline.md §'Cross-Proxy Adjudication'): Case A is NOT pre-judged; the HKR-nameability
    clause can fail independently of the rate.

    Conclusion: Case A licenses a future registry-landing compute (Level-2-BINDING, the VII.AF.1
    binding exemplar's sibling); Case B is the confirm-internal note (the loop-counting envelope stays
    a substrate-internal observable, no cross-pillar registry-PASS). The gate reports the binding_class
    token + alpha_fit + the HKR-nameability boolean; it does NOT land a registry entry this wave.

  the S104 registry-INCOMPLETE-PENDING status to BINDING-DECIDED-non-binding. Recorded as INFO =
  Case-B-confirm-internal.

  estimated_time: "1 gate (moment-ratio construction from the s84 cache + log-log alpha fit + HKR-image nameability analysis)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The substrate IS the D_K spectral triple; the normalized Hermitian moment
  M_m = Tr|D_K|^m / Tr|D_K|^0 is an intrinsic spectral functional of the fabric, NOT a measurement IN a
  container. The question is whether this substrate-IS truncation observable's L-convergence is a
  Level-2-BINDING bridge to a laboratory-IN continuum image (via a nameable HKR / Connes-Karoubi map) or
  merely a bare substrate-internal decomposition rate (the W16 non-binding wall). The direction of

  (Case A) HKR image bounding the continuum laboratory observable, or (Case B) a closed substrate-internal
  envelope with no laboratory image. The gate does NOT invert this — it tests for the HKR image rather

  matching L^{-3} exponent alone does NOT make the observable binding; the named HKR image is the
```
